BOOTSTRAP_UNIT_IS_THE_PASS_NOT_THE_FRAME: Declared in SPEC.md before the data was read. Adjacent frames share cache and governor state and are serially correlated, so resampling frames would understate the interval; the pass is a far closer approximation to an independent draw. Per-pass summaries are computed over EVERY timed frame while the committed raw arrays are subsampled every third frame, and the subsampling is stated wherever the raw arrays are used.
PRE_REGISTRATION: SPEC.md section 7 was written and committed BEFORE any measured timing data existed, and the commit ordering is verifiable in the repository history. Expectation: the declared operation-count model is stage-DEPENDENTLY wrong, not uniformly wrong, and the divergence spread max(R)/min(R) exceeds 3.
